verdict.rationale: The Snyk CLI has a public GitHub repository (github.com/snyk/cli), so at least part of the product's source can be read. The evidence never states a license for it, and nothing shows the core SaaS platform (Snyk Code, DeepCode AI, Remediation Agent, web app) is source-available. "Snyk Open Source" is the name of a scanning product, not a licensing statement about Snyk's own code. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented open-source license for the CLI repo, any evidence that the core platform or engines are open source, and independent confirmation of the licensing terms.
